stem: A and B are brothers. C is the sister of B. D is the mother of A. E is the father of C. How is D related to E?

per_option_rationale.rationale: A and B are brothers. C is B's sister, so C is also a sibling of A. D is A's mother, E is C's father. Since A, B, C are siblings, D and E are their parents: D is E's wife.
Student treats D as a sibling of E rather than tracing that D and E share the same children, placing D at the same generational level as E but in a sibling relation.
Student reverses the direction of the parent-child link, making D a child of E instead of a co-parent.
Student adds an extra generation upward, treating D as E's mother instead of E's wife.

explanation: A and B are brothers, and C is the sister of B, so A, B, C are all siblings. D is the mother of A, so D is the mother of all three siblings. E is the father of C, so E is the father of all three siblings. D and E are parents of the same children, making D the wife of E.

explanation_sections.punchline: Lock the sibling group first: A and B are brothers, C is B's sister, so A, B, C are all siblings. That is the cracking move - once you know D mothers and E fathers the SAME sibling group, the answer is immediate: D is E's wife.
explanation_sections.approach: Apply the most certain facts first. Step 1 (sibling group): A-B brothers, C-B sister, therefore A, B, C are siblings. Step 2 (parent assignment): D is A's mother, so D mothers the whole sibling group. E is C's father, so E fathers the whole sibling group. Step 3 (spouse inference): two people who are mother and father of the same children are spouses. D is E's wife. Verify: does any clue place D and E in a different generation? No. Confirm answer. This recipe - identify the sibling group, assign parents, infer spousal link - handles all one-chain blood-relation questions.
explanation_sections.lesson: The mother of a sibling group and the father of that same group are always spouses. Do not jump to sibling or parent-child labels before confirming the generation level.
explanation_sections.timing: About 60 seconds. Identifying the sibling group takes 15 seconds. Assigning parents takes 15 seconds. The trap is option 2 (Sister) - it treats D and E as same-generation siblings rather than co-parents. Check generation before labelling.
